platform: Windows 11; synthetic core/browser and read-only live emulator
runtime_hash_scope: Sorted POSIX paths; path UTF-8 + NUL + UTF-8 content normalized to LF. crates/**/*.{rs,toml,js,css,html}, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, plugins/calibration.example.json, plugins/*/plugin.json, crates/processor/parameter-library.json.

tests: global settings sections and chart gear shortcut
three sliders preview and cancel without saving
profile preferences save and survive page reload
appearance API authentication and invalid bounds
concurrent preference update refuses stale overwrite and preserves draft
defaults persist without changing core calibration
stable pseudorandom tile gradients, visible adjacent-track contrast, dashed grid and cached resize/scroll rendering
switching tabs during return to live clears history anchor
multiple intermediate scroll positions; settled target; bounded plot requests
parameter selection and separate calibration window
calibration zoom in/out changes both axes reversibly
calibration background pan preserves points, draft and core map
grid strokes and equal-valued ticks follow both pan axes
fit and signal-unit changes reset viewport
voltage/raw view roundtrip without changing points
external map revision preserves open editor; cancel reloads it

independent_checks: voltage points persisted as exact raw codes
interpreter result checked against independent formula
continuous synthetic ingestion; no COM access

limits: Settings sections/forms are currently built into the charts host, not a third-party form/plugin SDK.
Only charts appearance gains editable settings here; other plugin sections link to implemented screens or show existing capabilities.
Appearance preferences are local profile data, separate from core calibration and acquisition; not yet included in JSONL backup/core settings journal.
Profile persistence checked via file re-read and browser reload; no power-loss or long-duration acceptance.
Preview is coalesced to one delayed redraw per 32 ms; this is not a measured weak-machine/GPU performance guarantee.
